items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I went with a swinging little band out here, real fun band called Cee Pee Johnson

ctx.x: So, you were with Les Hite until 1939. (inaudible).

About 1939, then we went to -- I went with a swinging little band out here, real fun band called Cee Pee Johnson, and it was a real fun band. We had arrangements -- it was a copy band, only it was a small band. So, we copied

big band arrangements. We'd play everything that Jimmie Lunceford ever played and we'd play everything that Duke ever played or anybody that ever made anything good and on top of that, we had things that we did that nobody else did. Like we had parodies on "Poor Butterfly," like we had called it "The Big Pat Butterfly," you know, and we'd sing it with little commutations [sic] "That commutations like that. A Chick was high, like a big fat butterfly," and things, you know, and a real fun band and we were the…
